column7: BFO occurrent includes processes and process boundaries as well as event-like occurrents, so it is broader than logic:Event.
BFO's dependent-continuant category is broader than the modal notion carried by logic:Mode.
BFO has no relator category; this points only to its nearest dependent-continuant region.
BFO role is a specifically dependent realizable entity, while logic:Role is an anti-rigid type; the shared name does not warrant a close category match.
